notes: Original volumetric (Sieverts) H2 excess isotherms at 77, 87 and 298 K (up to 30 MPa) on zeolite-templated carbons ZTC-1/2/3 and commercial activated carbons MSC-30 and CNS-201; Table 1 rows marked 'From this study' give BET areas (e.g. ZTC-3 3591 ± 60 m2 g−1) and H2 capacities at 77 K / Gibbs excess maximum pressure and 296−303 K / 30 MPa.
